sentences.en: We have used our ration of coal for the week.
sentences.zh: 我们这一周的煤炭定量已经用完了。

sentences.en: They bargained additional rations of bread and milk.
sentences.zh: 他们讨价还价，争取多得到一些面包和牛奶的配给量。

sentences.en: He was caught stealing rations at the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 他被发现偷了厨房的食物定量。

senses.zh: 配给；定量供应；限定……的量
